info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Replace Pharmacy Prescriptions Transfer-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Transfer API facilitates the seamless updating of pharmacy prescriptions within the system. This endpoint allows for the efficient transfer of prescription details, ensuring accuracy and compliance in medication management. Pharmacies and healthcare providers can use this API to update prescription records, reflecting changes in patient care or medication dispensation. Typical consumers include pharmacy management systems and healthcare software, enabling them to maintain up-to-date information for improved patient outcomes.

put.summary: Transfer a prescription to another provider.
put.description: This operation allows for the transfer of a prescription from one healthcare provider to another, ensuring continuity of care for patients. It requires the details of the prescription and the receiving provider.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to transfer a prescription. It includes the necessary details required for the transfer operation, ensuring that all relevant information is captured and processed accordingly.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the transfer was completed.
